note: Descriptor for the GENERATED (not committed byte-by-byte) wiki-freshness-scale corpus. See README.md. scripts/benchmark/wiki-freshness-scale-fixture.ts's generateFreshnessScaleCorpus(size, seed) reads these exact numbers, so the same seed against these proportions always yields the same corpus.

checkpointBucketing.purpose: clusters VerifiedAt values onto a small number of shared base-revision commits rather than one distinct commit per page, so the fixture can distinguish a batching-by-base-revision implementation from a per-page one

dirtyCheckout.note: AFC-22 requires batching/caching to account for a dirty/untracked working tree. This task does not implement or budget for it (see the calibration profile's outOfScope); the flag is reserved so a later fixture extension does not have to renegotiate the manifest shape.
